page.overview:
What is Disney Princess?

Beauty and the Beast Cinderella Frozen The Little Mermaid Moana Mulan Sleeping Beauty Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs Tangled Whisker Haven Build and Swap

Disney Princess is a licensed sub-theme of Disney that was introduced in 2012 as its own theme. Disney Princess became a sub-theme of Disney in 2017.

The theme has also spawned two animated specials: LEGO Disney Princesses: The Castle Quest and LEGO Disney Princess: Villains Unite.

The DUPLO sets mainly follow the main events in the stories of the princesses known from Disney's classic animated feature-length films. Each set depicts a scene from their respective films. All of the sets are based around a particular location.
